Commentary.Commentary: 134 to win for New Zealand. This pitch looks to be on the slower side and it is not going to be easy for any new batter to score runs. India have shown that they can defend totals over 130 in this tournament and will rely on their spinners again to go through to the semis today itself. New Zealand, on the other hand, will aim to bat sensibly and target the bowlers who are loose. Stay tuned for the run chase.

Good comeback by New Zealand. In fact, take aside Shafali Verma's knock and it will show that they have really bowled well. Amelia Kerr was the one who put the brakes and she, along with Leigh Kasperek, stifled the Indians. Their combined figures were 8-0-40-3.

Well, another score in the range of 130-150 for India. The fact that they collapsed again, after a good start, shows how heavily they rely on the top order. It was a Shafali Verma show today, tonking the bowlers to all parts in the Powerplay. During her 51-run stand for the second wicket with Taniya Bhatia, it did seem like 150 was on. But Bhatia's wicket triggered a collapse and India lost their way.

Leigh Kasperek is down for a chat with Anjum Chopra. She is happy with the way New Zealand pulled things back. Is happy with the target to chase. On being asked about any specific restrictions against India, Kasperek says that there was no such plan and they just tried to play as the game progressed. On the plan to bowl short to Shafali and full to Taniya, Kasperek says that Verma is more of a front foot player and the latter a back foot one, hence the bowling lengths. On her personally looking to open the batting, Leigh smiles and says that she just looks to contribute with the bat whenever an opportunity arises.

OUT! RUN OUT! Radha Yadav is run out but it does not matter. She has played a nice cameo. Full and outside off, Radha gets across and looks to paddle. Gets a top edge which just eludes short fine leg. The fielder, Leigh Kasperek, gets to the ball and then picks it up. By that time, Pandey is already at the bowler's end for the second. But Radha is busy plonking her bat at that end. She has to run for the second and is comfortably short. INDIA END ON 133/8!
SIX! This one goes all the way! Full and outside off, Radha leans and lofts it brilliantly over long off!
Full and outside off, Yadav looks to go over mid off and clears the fielder. Two runs taken.
Gets across her stumps, looks to flick but misses and is hit on the pads. The ball deflects towards square leg and a leg bye is taken.
Works this through mid-wicket for a run.
Outside off, pushed through point for a single.
Hayley Jensen to bowl the final over. 2-0-9-0 so far.
MISSED STUMPING! Full and outside off, Radha comes down the track and swings hard but misses. Rachel Priest behind the stumps fumbles as well and misses an easy stumping.
Pushes this down to long off for a run.
Full and down the leg side, swept through mid-wicket for a couple.
Safe as a house. Radha pushes this towards cover and takes off for a quick single. There is a direct hit at the bowler's end and it is referred upstairs. Nothing harmful for India.
Direct hit! Is that a wicket? Referred upstairs... Nope. The batter is well in.
Full and down the leg side, worked through square leg for a couple.
Outside off, punched through the covers for a single.
Leigh Kasperek to bowl the 19th over. 3-0-12-1 so far.
Chipped in the air, but does not carry to long on. Lands in front of the fielder. A single taken.
On middle and leg, worked through mid-wicket for one more.
A short ball, wide outside off, Radha flashes hard but misses.
A short ball, pulled towards fine leg for a single.
Outside off, good change in pace, Shikha looks to run it towards third man but misses.
Radha Yadav walks in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Terrific shot but straight to the fielder. Full and around middle, Deepti gets down and plays the slog. The connection is good but it is straight to deep mid-wicket. Hayley Jensen takes a sitter.
Sophie Devine is back on. 1-0-9-0 so far.
Works this down the leg side for one more.
The batter dances down the track. They manage to come back for the second.
Comes down the track and works it through mid-wicket for a run.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Full and outside off, worked through mid-wicket for a run.
Outside off, punched off the back foot for a single.
Anna Peterson to bowl now. 1-0-13-0 so far.
Outside off, punched off the back foot for one more.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full and around middle, watchfully defended.
Shikha Pandey walks in at number 6, replacing Veda.

OUT! LBW! Decision reversed! Perhaps the umpire thought there was glove involved, because it seemed there was a deflection. Full and straight, Krishnamurthy looked to sweep but missed and was hit on the pads. Kerr appealed but the umpire was firm in shaking his head. The keeper, bowler and another fielder had a conversation and eventually took the review. Ultra Edge confirmed there was no bat or glove while the Ball Tracker returned three reds. Hitting the middle stump.

Review for LBW! New Zealand reckon that Krishnamurthy is caught plumb in front. There is a three-way discussion and eventually, the review is taken. Good decision. To take the review. Because Ball Tracker shows this to be plumb!
FOUR! That is a fine shot. Landed outside off, Krisnamurthy leans and punches this between cover and point!
Short and outside off, cut straight to point.
The batter plays a sweep shot.
A short ball, stays low, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a run. That was nicely played.
The batsman works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.
Full on middle, pushed through to long on for another single.

DROPPED! Maddy Green puts down another chance. Full and around middle, Deepti gets down and slog sweeps it towards deep mid-wicket. Maddy Green comes running in and takes the catch but wait, spills it. A run taken.
Dead ball. Kasperek releases the ball but Deepti backs away at the last moment.
Full and straight, Deepti looks to defend but the ball runs off the inner half of the bat towards short fine leg.
Full and on middle, swept through mid-wicket for a run.
Veda Krishnamurthy to bat now.

OUT! CAUGHT! Verma eventually holes out. She has been trying her best to get out in the last few deliveries and finally, finds the fielder. Full and outside off, Shafali backs away and lofts it towards wide long off. Easy catch for the fielder, Hayley Jensen.

Is that a catch? The keeper is convinced. But not the bowler. No review taken. A short ball, outside off, Verma gets across, looks to pull but misses. The keeper collects and then appeals but the umpire shakes his head. There is a discussion between keeper and bowler but no review taken.
Works this down the leg side for a run.
Around middle, worked straight to short mid-wicket.
A short ball, pulled down to long on for a single.
Amelia Kerr comes on now. 2-0-13-0 so far.
Deepti Sharma walks in now.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Tame, tame dismissal. Full and outside off, Kaur comes forward, looks to drive straight but ends up chipping a tame return catch back to the bowler. Kasperek does not drop Kaur. 3/25 in the last 24 balls.
Outside off, driven through mid off for another run.
Full and on middle, swept through mid-wicket for a single.
Full and down the leg side, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
Comes down the track, but is cramped for room as the ball is on the pads. Placed straight to short mid-wicket.
Around off, watchfully defended.
WIDE. Full and down the leg side, Kaur misses her flick.
Hayley Jensen is back on. 2-0-9-0 so far. In fact, mind change. Kasperek continues.
SIX! Terrific shot! A length ball, around off, Shafali comes down the track and lofts it straight down the ground for a maximum! A wicket from the over but 10 runs from it as well.
A smart bouncer, following the batter down the leg side, SV is down the track, thinks about the pull but then bails out.
Landed outside off, Verma guides this towards third man but short third man dives to her right and makes a brilliant stop.
FOUR! A welcome boundary for India. Short and outside off, Verma cuts it over short third man and finds the fence.

Oohhh... she is struggling with her fitness, Shafali. Hence, she is looking to go after every ball. Not that she plays defensive strokes very much. Jumps down the track and has a wild swing at the ball, only to miss.
In walks the skipper, Harmanpreet Kaur.

OUT! CAUGHT! Gone off the leading edge. New Zealand have been below average in the field and the moment this went up in the air, hearts would have been in their mouths. Full and down the leg side, would have been a wide had it been left alone but Jemimah just looks to work it down the leg side. She ends up being a bit early into the shot and gets a leading edge. The ball lobs in the air and Amelia Kerr takes another catch at backward point.
Full and down the leg side, flicked away for one more.
A short ball, pulled to deep mid-wicket for another single.
Full on the pads, flicked towards deep mid-wicket for one.
Full and around middle, Verma comes down the track and lofts it down to long on for a run.
Outside off, Rodrigues comes down the track and drives it down the ground for a single.
Full and on middle, flicked towards mid-wicket.
Leigh Kasperek into the attack now.

DROPPED! That is straight in and out. Poor fielding display by the Kiwis so far. Short and outside off, Shafali plays a tired pull and it goes straight to Lea Tahuhu at short mid-wicket. She takes the catch but then while attempting to celebrate, loses control.
Full and outside off, played through the covers for a single.
Short and outside off, punched behind point for a well-run couple.

MISFIELD, FOUR! Not what you need when you have just taken a wicket. Full and outside off, Rodrigues drives it towards mid on. Suzie Bates gets across to her right to stop but the ball goes beneath her hands to the fence behind.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
Jemimah Rodrigues walks in next.

OUT! CAUGHT! That is straight to the fielder. India will be the happier side though. Full and outside off, Bhatia leans and drives it uppishly. She cannot find the gap and finds the fielder instead. Amelia Kerr joins hands with Rosemary Mair in breaking the partnership.
Rosemary Mair returns. 1-0-10-0 so far.
Around off, Verma looks to punch but mistimes it back to the bowler.
FOUR! That is an excellent shot and the 50-RUN STAND IS UP AS WELL. Short and outside off, Verma goes back and punches it between short third man and backward point.
Short and outside off, punched through the covers for another single.
Full and outside off, Verma mistimes her loft towards long off for one more.
Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a run.
Full and outside off, Shafali comes down the track and looks to go inside out but skews it over cover. Just a single taken.

DROPPED! Well, well, well. New Zealand were just gaining some momentum. Has Green led the proposed rub of the green go away from her team? Full and around off, Verma comes down the track and looks to go downtown. However, she mistimes it straight to Maddy Green at long on. Green comes running in slightly, gets to the ball but puts it down. A single taken.
On middle, pushed towards mid on.
A short ball, around off, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a single.

That is a good follow-up delivery, cramping the batter for room, following Bhatia down the leg side as she backs away, Taniya can only push it towards cover. She is out of the crease and the fielder returns a sharp throw to the keeper. Rachel Priest collects and whips the bails off and appeals - not once, not twice but thrice. She believes that Bhatia plonked her bat it. But the square leg umpire shakes his head. No replays shown.
Outside off, played straight to point.
FOUR! That is just too easy at the start of an over. A half tracker, right in the middle of the pitch, Bhatia pulls it over mid-wicket and finds the fence.
Landed outside off, driven beautifully but straight to the fielder at cover.
Full and outside off, eased through the covers for a single.
FOUR! That is a freebie. A full toss, on middle, Bhatia gets down and sweeps it behind square leg for a boundary!

Full and outside off, excellent change of pace, Taniya looks to steer it to third man but is beaten for lack of pace. The ball takes the inside edge and goes to short fine leg. Bhatia wants the single but is sent back.
Landed outside off, dabbed to short third man.
Full and outside off, Bhatia comes down the track and squeezes it towards point.
Amelia Kerr to bowl now.
Full and around off, watchfully defended. 49/1 in the Powerplay for India.
Outside off, this is played through point for a single.
Fullish delivery on middle, Taniya pushes it to point.
Length ball on middle, Bhatia defends it out off the back foot.
Length ball on off, Verma drives it uppishly towards the mid off region and crosses over for a single.
Short ball on middle, Bhatia pulls it to mid-wicket for a single.
Hayley Jensen is into the attack.
SIX! Another one. Brilliant end to the over for India. Verma dances down the track and converts this to a full toss. She lifts this over the long on region for a biggie.
SIX! Excellent use of the feet. Floated on off, Verma dances down the track and then lifts it over the long on region for the first maximum of the game.
Flighted outside off, Verma plays it to the mid on fielder.
Full delivery on off, Bhatia sweeps it to deep square leg for a single.
Looped up ball around off, Bhatia looks to sweep but gets hit on the pads. There is a stifled appeal for LBW but nothing from the umpire.
Flatter one outside off, punched to point.
Anna Peterson is on now.
FOUR! Whacked! Short delivery on middle, Verma clears her front leg and pulls it to the deep mid-wicket region for a boundary.
The batsman has played it to the point region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
On a length on middle, Taniya backs away and defends it to the off side.
Good length ball on off, Bhatia drives it to mid off for another dot.
On middle, Bhatia flicks it to the deep square leg region for a couple.
Wide! Fullish delivery down the leg side, Bhatia looks to flick but fails to get any bat on it. Wide signaled.
Length ball outside off, Verma plays it to the third man region for a single.
Sophie Devine is on now.

FOUR! Full toss and it has been put away! Low full toss on middle, Bhatiya flicks it to the deep square leg region. The fielder comes across and dives but fails to stop it. End of a successful over for New Zealand.
Length ball on off, Verma guides it to third man for a single.
Uppish but safe! Full delivery on middle, Shafali looks to lift it over mid on but does not time it well. Luckily for her, it lands in front of the mid on fielder.
WIDE! Short ball outside the off stump line, Verma leaves it alone. Wide signaled for height.
Bhatia is underway! Good length ball down the leg side, Taniya flicks it to short fine leg for a single.
Taniya Bhatia is the next batter in.

OUT! DRAGGED ON!   Poor shot. There was no footwork. The White Ferns are ecstatic as they see the back of the dangerous Smriti Mandhana. Full delivery outside off, Mandhana looks to guide it to third man but gets an inside edge and it goes onto hit the stumps. Good start for the White Ferns.
Good length ball on the pads, Mandhana flicks it to the deep square leg region for a couple.
FOUR! Slapped! Short delivery outside off, Verma stays inside her crease and hammers it towards deep cover for a boundary. First one for Verma in this innings. 10 off the over.
Swing and a miss! Fullish delivery outside off, Verma looks to heave it away but fails to get any bat on it.
Play and a miss! Back of a length ball outside off, Verma looks to cut but misses it altogether.
Another one short of a length. It is bowled outside off, Smriti plays it towards mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Pulled away nicely! Mandhana averages 48 on this ground indicating that she loves this ground. Short ball on off, Smriti pulls it over the mid on fielder for a boundary.
Mair starts with a back of a length ball around off, Verma guides it to third man for a single.
Rosemary Mair will bowl from the other end.
Length ball outside off, Mandhana punches it to cover. 5 runs from the first over.
FOUR! Up and over! First boundary for India! Good length ball outside off, Mandhana lifts it over the cover fielder for a boundary. Two fielders chase after it but fail to get there in time.
Back of a length ball around off, Smriti pushes it to the cover fielder.
On a length on middle, Mandhana defends it off the back foot.
India are underway! Good length ball on off, Verma looks to defend but the ball takes the outside edge and goes through the vacant slip cordon towards third man. The batters take a single.
Tahuhu starts with a length ball outside off, Shafali Verma looks to punch it off the back foot but fails to get any bat on it. It goes on the bounce to the keeper.
We are all set to begin the game! The New Zealand players make their way out onto the field after being in a huddle followed by Smriti Mandhana and Shafali Verma. Lea Tahuhu will start with the ball.
Both teams are out there in the field for their respective National Anthems. First up is the New Zealand National Anthem followed by India's.

Pitch report - Ian Bishop says that the bowlers have to bowl slightly back of a length on this pitch. Adds that there is a bit of grass on this wicket. States that there are some cracks on it as well but the pitch is a good one for batting.

New Zealand (Playing XI)- Sophie Devine (C), Rachel Priest (WK), Suzie Bates, Maddy Green, Katey Martin, Amelia Kerr, Hayley Jensen, Anna Peterson (In place of Katie Perkins), Leigh Kasperek, Lea Tahuhu, Rosemary Mair (In place of Jess Kerr).

India (Playing XI) - Shafali Verma, Smriti Mandhana (In place of Richa Ghosh), Jemimah Rodrigues, Harmanpreet Kaur (C), Deepti Sharma, Veda Krishnamurthy, Shikha Pandey, Taniya Bhatia (WK),  Radha Yadav ( In place of Arundhati Reddy), Poonam Yadav, Rajeshwari Gayakwad.

Harmanpreet Kaur, the Indian skipper, says that they would have batted first. Adds that they have made two changes. Smriti Mandhana and Radha Yadav come in for Richa Ghosh and Arundhati Reddy. States that they need to improve batting in the overs between 7 to 14.

Sophie Devine, the New Zealand skipper, says they are bowling first as there is a bit of rain around and they would look to make use of the conditions. Goes onto say that they have made two changes to their side. Adds that India is a dangerous side and they would have to be on their toes.
Toss - New Zealand have won the toss and they elect to field first.

Match no.9 sees two in-form teams facing each other, India and New Zealand. India, on the back of two consecutive wins are just one win away from securing a place in the semi-finals. Smriti Mandhana is likely to return for this crucial fixture and that is a big boost for the batting line-up of the Indians. Their bowlers have done a wonderful job and would hope to continue doing the same. The White Ferns, on the other hand, started the tournament well against Sri Lanka but now are facing a tough opponent in India. They have a strong side at their disposal and would want them to come good and move one step closer to the semi-final stage. Will India enter the semi-finals with one game to spare or will New Zealand manage back-to-back wins? Toss and team updates in a while.
